outline_shape.source: REF_OUTLINE_PX (typed-in measurement of the reference outline, round 3's instrument), harmonics 2..12, weighted (1 - z^2) so it acts on the limb

height_guard.what: smokebomb_ball.Ball.guard_heights: a covering stretch's top is kept 0.08 mm + its LOD0 body-chord sag above the highest top beneath it, wherever it can be seen (exposed or within 0.45 mm of it)

sink.what: a buried run dives this far below its stacked height from ramp[0] to ramp[1] mm in under its cover (hidden), so no buried vertex or cord stands through a cover's chords

atlas.layout: one block per chunk: u along +x, t (across, centred) up the image, one texel = 1/ppmm mm of cloth everywhere; V = t so no island is mirrored

recolour.bc_is_detail_x_tint: BC8 = sRGB8(sRGBdecode(Detail8 / 255) x Tint), built from the quantised Detail (Detail stored sRGB-encoded, imported sRGB ON)

specular_mask.mask: saturate(d)^2, box-filtered from the float detail

textures.cloth_module: props_lib.smokebomb_cloth.ClothSpec6 (defaults = the whole-ball calibration; Detail units)

unreal_material.shading_model: Default Lit (legacy) or Substrate Slab; opaque; no Cloth/Fuzz layer
unreal_material.BaseColor: T_SmokeBomb_Detail.R x Tint  (Tint default = tint_linear; equals T_SmokeBomb_BC at the default Tint, at every mip)
unreal_material.Detail_encoding: sRGB-encoded LINEAR detail d = albedo / Tint luminance, full range, quantised once from linear float data; import with sRGB ON (TC_Grayscale, G8): Unreal decodes before filtering and builds its mips in linear light, as it does for BC
unreal_material.BaseColor_alt: T_SmokeBomb_BC (sRGB) directly, for a fixed-colour instance
unreal_material.Specular_note: ORM.A is the BAKED specular mask saturate(d)^2 (d = the linear detail), box-filtered from float data before quantisation, so every mip averages the final quantity. Do NOT use a constant Specular: 0.5 greys the cloth (p50 +53 %, p10 +111 % at the reference view); the look depends on this pin
unreal_material.Recolour: change Tint only; Specular and roughness do not follow the dye

textures.ORM: linear (sRGB OFF), TC_Masks, RGBA (A = specular mask)

how_each_channel_is_made.Detail: sRGB-ENCODED LINEAR detail, full range: sRGB(d) of the linear float detail d (0..1) painted in TAPE space (smokebomb_cloth.cloth_texels, ClothSpec6: warp ribs with weft ticks in most breaks and cross-dots along the picks (a thin crosshatch), elongated glints on the crests, few curled fibres and specks, the rolled edge as the weave turning over with irregular knuckles, sparse wraps and long stretches where it fades out, a soft crevice under each covering edge), quantised once; import sRGB ON; linear albedo = Detail x Tint
how_each_channel_is_made.BC: sRGB8 of sRGBdecode(Detail8 / 255) x Tint (so a material doing Detail x Tint reproduces it, at every mip)
how_each_channel_is_made.ORM.A: the SPECULAR mask saturate(d)^2, box-filtered from the float detail to the ORM size before quantisation (Specular = 0.5 x ORM.A)
how_each_channel_is_made.ORM.R: the analytic crevice / groove occlusion x a Cycles AO bake of LOD0 alone (Unreal's indirect AO)
how_each_channel_is_made.ORM.G: roughness 0.90 +- 0.03 on the weave, 0.68 on glints and specks, 0.70 on fibres, 0.95 in crevices
how_each_channel_is_made.N: DirectX, from the cloth's micro height (ribs, knuckles, fibres) plus the section relief (the true rolled cord, groove and crown minus LOD0's section chords, smokebomb_cloth.section_relief); the macro shape is geometry
